project_overview.project_summary: This design production project centers on Logo needed for UK start up catering company. The initial brief says: ** Thank you for sending your proposals. We look forward to reviewing them all soon. The work sits mainly in Web design and development, Graphic and editorial design, Design & Creative. Stable project themes include visual concept and layout, brand and style consistency, production-ready exports. The available evidence includes 66 conversation messages, 28 deliverable files, which together document the brief, collaboration, review cycle, and delivered work. The recoverable artifacts span .ai, .docx, .eps, .jpg, .pdf, .psd, .png formats; their contents were used only where they supplied stable domain, production, architecture, or handoff information. For onboarding, the key task is to understand the intended audience, source assets, production workflow, review loop, delivery formats, and constraints that determine acceptance. No inspectable software repository was identified, so technical details are limited to what the brief, conversation, and artifacts explicitly establish.
